title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Suggested Abbreviations
summary: Reference list of suggested abbreviations for Business Central. It covers the short forms for AL object types used in file names, short forms for common business words, and financial and time-period abbreviations. The author recompiled it because the original Microsoft Dynamics 365 Community post is no longer available.
key_points: Gives file-naming abbreviations for AL object types, for example PageExt, TableExt, EnumExt and PermissionSetExt
Maps common words to short forms, such as Cust for customer, Inv for invoice and Whse for warehouse
Includes period and reporting abbreviations like YTD, PY, FY, MOM and LCY
Recreates a Microsoft Community list that has since been taken down

quotes.text: Use the listed abbreviations for each type of object in the file naming
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the standard for consistent AL object naming across Business Central development

quotes.text: I have re-compiled the list here, and I hope this serves as a helpful reference for anyone in need
quotes.why_it_matters: The post recreates a previously unavailable Microsoft abbreviations guide, making it a practical resource for developers
